name: mock-interview-ai
description: Vite SPA front-end for the AI mock interview platform. Talks to the Rust backend over REST + WebSocket; uses Web Speech APIs for voice and PDF.js to parse resumes.

scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:imports
scripts.check:js: for f in $(find src -name '*.js' | sort; find scripts -name '*.cjs' | sort); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
